world_definitions.W0_FIXTURE: scenario fixture (every demonstration starts here: acquisition is sandboxed)
world_definitions.W3_RELATION_WITNESSES: W0 + per pool person: EMAIL WHO=p, CALL RECIPIENT=p, MESSAGE RECIPIENT=p (outer REQUEST), MESSAGE WHO=p; per pool topic: CALL TOPIC=t; per pool place: EMAIL WHERE=pl, CALL WHERE=pl; alternate ones CLOSED

signature: canonical JSON of (status, rendered return incl. order, full canonical world state after the program)
reference: gold family steps for the demonstration's own EXAMPLE values (missing example values -> no reference -> not equivalent)
CALL semantics: gold procedures of earlier curriculum items
complete_demo: behaviorally_equivalent(P, G) iff signature equal on every world
incomplete_demo: world state after P equals the state after SOME prefix of G on every world (no return compared)

metrics.WRONG_BEHAVIORAL_ACTION_EXECUTED: count of executed demonstrations (>=1 executed step) not equivalent, excluding registered legal-bad / relation-swap injected demonstrations (scored as LEGAL_BAD_SANDBOX_EXECUTED)
metrics.GROUNDING_BEHAVIORAL_EXACT: over non-injected demonstrations whose LESSON is faithful (scripted: by construction; hosted teacher: judge faithful AND no lexical unrequested status): completed and equivalent
metrics.FIRST_PASS_GROUNDING_BEHAVIORAL_EXACT: same, demonstration 1 with zero clarification exchanges
metrics.TEACHER_LESSON_BEHAVIORAL_EXACT: hosted-teacher arms: judge faithful AND no lexical unrequested status predicate
metrics.TEACHER_UNREQUESTED_CONSTRAINT_RATE: per non-injected target: any lesson line with a status word when the registered goal has none (deterministic regex evaluator/judge.py STATUS_WORDS)
metrics.LINE_GROUNDING_STRUCTURAL_EXACT: scripted arms: per registered lesson line, executed steps == gold unit steps (variable names ignored)
metrics.RELATION_BINDING_EXACT: FIND/FILTER (type, scope.relation) multiset equal, by relation family
